# OSINT Source Registry

A review-gated catalog of public information source metadata.

- Repository: https://github.com/PCakes303/osint-source-registry
- Maturity: scaffolding
- Scope: source metadata, terms/licensing references, access constraints, review state, permitted purposes, and retention.
- Explicit non-scope: crawling, scraping, downloading, API calls, collection, enrichment, legal determinations, or source authentication.
- Main documentation: README.md
- Agent instructions: AGENTS.md
- Source record contract: docs/SOURCE-RECORD-CONTRACT.md
- Threat model: docs/THREAT-MODEL.md
- Schema: schemas/source-record.schema.json
- Package: osint_source_registry/
- Tests: tests/
- Dependencies: Resource Manifest, Schema Registry, Audit & Provenance; all declared, none integration-tested.
